verdict.seen: A pit is dug with dirt flying, then a steel tank with a vent pipe appears in the pit filled with amber gasoline.
Blue drips fall from the tank bottom and dark dots seep down through the soil toward the water, with a LEAKING label.
The groundwater band turns from blue to murky yellow-green across the frames while seepage continues above.
Leak drips at the bare tank, then a green fiberglass wall wraps the tank and the drips stop.
Amber fuel is visible as a thin layer in the gap at the bottom between the green and steel walls.
A red-ball sensor appears on a pole and in the gap, with the red light flashing bright then dim.
Dark fuel blob runs down beside the fill pipe from the sidewalk edge with a SPILL label.
The spill is shown first, then a black bucket disc appears around the pipe and the spill is gone.
A yellow outline rectangle is drawn around the top of the tank, which is shown clearly with the sensor.
A concrete slab appears over the tank with a red fuel pump and the bucket on top, resting on the slab.
The whole finished build is in view: tank, slab, pump and bucket, with the camera pulling back and nothing covering it.
